exercises.title: 7. Pratique: Academic register — precise verbs and nominal groups

items.prompt: 'Leaders learn best from hard jobs.' → The ___ of leadership capability occurs primarily through exposure to consequential challenges.
items.hintAfterError: Precisamos do substantivo formado a partir do verbo (terminação -ion).

items.prompt: 'Thinking about what happened helps leaders grow.' → Structured ___ converts experiential learning into transferable leadership insight.
'Mentors matter more than courses.' → Sustained mentorship ___ formal curriculum in the development of senior leaders.
items.hintAfterError: O sujeito 'mentorship' é singular e o sentido é 'supera'.

items.prompt: 'Companies don't invest enough in time for reflection.' → Chronic ___ in protected reflective time erodes the returns on leadership development.
'Good programmes match the hard job to the person's weakness.' → Effective development programmes ___ stretch assignments with identified capability gaps.
